newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Bank of Taiwan to issue US$200 mln Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Taiwan to issue US$200 mln Eurobond.

text.p: Bank of Taiwan, the island's top state-run bank, said on Thursday it would issue US$200 million worth of Eurobonds in Luxembourg at the end of October, the first Eurobond by a Taiwan bank.
"The five-year US$200 million Eurobond will be the first issue by a Taiwanese bank," a Bank of Taiwan executive told Reuters, asking that his name not be used.
The bank has chosen Goldman Sachs as the lead underwriter for the issue, he said.
"According to our initial estimate, the Eurobond will have a rate of LIBOR plus 13 to 15 bp," he said.
The Eurobond will be issued in a non-physical or global note style, he said.
After the formal issue at the end of October, the Eurobond will be traded in Europe, he said.
